requirements.title: make the student perform a recognizable modern PLC engineering lifecycle
requirements.atomicRequirement:
MUST make the student perform a recognizable modern PLC engineering lifecycle:
Create or open a simulator-native project.
Add fictional virtual controllers and devices.
Configure virtual racks, modules, channels, addresses, logical networks, and topology.
Create tags, constants, data types, and data blocks.
create OB, FC, FB, instance DB, and global DB program structures.
Program in LAD, FBD, and SCL (Structured Text).
Compile genuine project, hardware, language, type, and dependency semantics.
Repair real inconsistencies and rebuild.
Start a fictional controller instance.
Review an internal Virtual Load Preview.
Perform an atomic Virtual Download to a VirtualControllerId.
Use RUN, STOP, monitoring, watch, modify, force, and trace semantics.
Operate a deterministic virtual process and virtual HMI.
Diagnose causal code, hardware, network-graph, process, and HMI faults.
Correct the underlying cause and verify the result.
